name: Microchip Technology
description: A leading provider of microcontroller, mixed-signal, analog and Flash-IP integrated circuits, serving industrial, automotive, consumer, and IoT markets worldwide.
whyChoose: Broad, reliable memory and MCU portfolio.

name: ABB
description: A global technology leader in electrification and automation, ABB enables a more sustainable and resource-efficient future through building and industrial automation products.

name: Analog Devices
description: A global semiconductor leader in the design and manufacture of analog, mixed-signal, and DSP integrated circuits used in virtually every kind of electronic equipment.

name: CTHINGS
description: CTHINGS.CO designs compact wireless connectivity modules and edge-IoT cards that simplify adding Bluetooth, Thread and Zigbee connectivity to embedded products.

name: OKYSTAR
description: OKYSTAR develops affordable environmental and atmospheric sensor modules widely used by makers and educators for weather-station and monitoring projects.

name: Transcend
description: Transcend Information is a global leader in storage and multimedia products, including industrial-grade flash memory cards trusted in embedded and single-board-computer designs.

name: SpotSee
description: SpotSee (formerly Shockwatch) manufactures indicators that monitor temperature, shock, and tilt exposure during shipping and storage, including the WarmMark family of temperature labels.

name: TE Connectivity
description: TE Connectivity designs and manufactures connectivity and sensor solutions for harsh and everyday environments across industrial, automotive, and communications markets.

name: Ezurio
description: Ezurio (formerly Laird Connectivity) builds wireless modules and sensor solutions that help engineers deliver connected products faster.

name: MEDER
description: MEDER Electronic (Standex Meder) specializes in reed switch and reed relay based sensing technology, including liquid-level and proximity sensors.

name: ON Semiconductor
description: onsemi is a premier supplier of intelligent power and sensing technologies, including CMOS image sensors used in industrial and machine-vision cameras.

name: Amphenol
description: Amphenol is one of the world's largest producers of interconnect products and sensors, spanning automotive, industrial, and environmental monitoring applications.

name: Same Sky
description: Same Sky (formerly CUI Devices) designs board-level components including memory card connectors, audio, and motion products for embedded systems.

name: Texas Instruments
description: Texas Instruments designs analog and embedded processing chips, including battery-management and charging ICs used across billions of electronic products.

name: CUI Inc
description: CUI Inc. develops power electronics including AC-DC and DC-DC modules, delivering efficient and compact power conversion for embedded and industrial systems.

name: Banner Engineering
description: Banner Engineering builds sensors and industrial indicator/signaling products, including stack lights that communicate machine status on the factory floor.

name: Broadcom
description: Broadcom is a global infrastructure technology leader supplying semiconductor and optical components, including high-speed fiber optic transceivers.

name: Raystar Optronics
description: Raystar Optronics manufactures character, graphic, and OLED display modules used across industrial and consumer electronic products.

name: CONXALL
description: Conxall Corporation manufactures rugged circular connectors used in demanding industrial, medical, and military applications.

name: JAE
description: Japan Aviation Electronics (JAE) is a global connector manufacturer producing high-reliability interconnects for automotive, industrial and consumer electronics.

name: OptoSupply
description: OptoSupply manufactures a broad range of LEDs and optoelectronic emitters for signaling, backlighting, and infrared sensing applications.

name: Lite-On
description: Lite-On Technology is a diversified electronics manufacturer producing optoelectronic components including LED displays and emitters.

name: SmartElex
description: SmartElex is an India-based supplier of sensors, motor drivers, and robotics components popular among Indian makers and engineering students.

name: EasyMech
description: EasyMech designs mechanical and electronic building blocks — motors, drivers, and sensors — tailored for robotics education and DIY projects in India.

name: Cytron
description: Cytron Technologies is a Malaysia-based robotics and electronics company known for motor drivers, controllers, and maker-friendly boards across Southeast Asia.
